findings.text: note, new criterion: a bound test pins the hint at the rcf project root ("ran at ." for a red unmutated run of a test with no package.json above it); the check 4 read found test/cli/audit-test-strength-workspace.test.js:534 asserts only the apps/api form, so the "." branch of src/audit/test-strength/index.js:347 is unpinned

note, new criterion: a failing git ls-tree in workspacePackages (src/audit/test-strength/index.js:135) exits with a named error instead of returning no packages; at 4ce63ae2 the failure is swallowed, so the working copy links and the backstop roots silently drop every workspace package (production diff read, check 4)

note, new criterion: a re-pointed workspace link whose target needs a path absent from the HEAD checkout (gitignored build output such as dist/) gets its own stderr reason; at 4ce63ae2 (src/audit/test-strength/runner.js:206 to :210) the copy link resolves to a package without its dist/, and a reviewer probe of a hoisted npm workspace consuming apps/lib through a gitignored dist/ exits 2 with the unmutated-run line and the "cwd": "project" hint, which points the wrong way (0.39.0 ran that test green unmutated, its mutants surviving)

note, new criterion: TAC-4155 responsibilities[4] states whether a symbolic-link entry in the node_modules of the rcf project and its ancestors is re-pointed into the copy (the link form src/audit/test-strength/runner.js:206 to :208 applies at 4ce63ae2) or keeps its 0.39.0 absolute link; "which stay linked as 0.39.0 links them" reads two ways (builder gap (a); the stage-keeper accepted the builder reading for this round and rules a DEFINE sharpening next round)

note, new criterion: the reason decodes the quoted error scalar node:test TAP writes (src/verify/suite/index.js:126 to :131, yamlScalar): a thrown C:\dir\file gives the reason C:\\dir\\file and a message holding both quote kinds keeps its backtick quoting (reviewer probe at 4ce63ae2); a test-author case for each escape form under AC-20101-8, then the builder decodes it (the stage-keeper ruling on the independent review, note 1)

note, new criterion: the verify run help (src/verify/cli/run.js:288 to :290) states the reason rule as TAC-4157 interfaces[1] does: the first non-empty line of the error of the first failing case in the row tests order, trimmed, else the last non-empty stderr line, else the no-result reason; at 4ce63ae2 the parenthetical abbreviates it (the stage-keeper ruling on the independent review, note 2)
